phase_prompt.summary: The Head of Thousands stands vigil at the celestial gate, managing the division of the day with stoic resolve.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A medium cinematic shot of a Head of Thousands, a regal obsidian figure, manipulating a floating holographic interface with a rod of solid light. The figure is framed against the blinding ingress gate of the sun, silhouette sharp against the plasma brilliance. The robes of fiber optic cable glow with internal data streams. The mood is solemn and weighty, emphasizing the burden of timekeeping in the simulation. High contrast, physically based rendering, hyper-realistic textures.
